title: Executable and package naming
description: The required importable commonmark/ package occupies the same root path as a root executable named commonmark, so both cannot exist in this filesystem layout. I kept the package acceptance contract and added the commonmark console entry point plus bin/commonmark launcher.

title: Use a self-contained parser implementation
description: The stack selects Python 3 and the standard library, and Compass prohibits a public Markdown implementation. Use an in-house parser organized around block parsing, inline parsing, and HTML rendering.

options.label: Implement the parser in the project

title: Use the conventional CLI response contract
description: The source requires UTF-8 input and HTML output but does not specify malformed input handling or other process failures. Use exit status zero for successful conversion and a nonzero exit status for input or execution errors, reporting errors on standard error.

options.label: Return zero on success and nonzero on errors
